name: Kazerne Willem
description: The Ringdijk fire station has seven glazed vehicle bays under tall black charred-wood panels, pale brick piers and rows of office windows.
funFact: Willem preserves the W of Weesper: the station began at Weesperplein in 1873, moved to Nieuwe Achtergracht in 1909, and has operated from Ringdijk since 1984. The renovated panels above the fire-engine doors use charred Marugame wood selected by ENZO architects for its durability.
